target_vertical: Multi-channel retailer / DTC brand (Shopify + Amazon + Etsy + eBay + Walmart sellers)
pricing_model: Tiered subscription based on monthly sales order volume from all connected stores; differs by number of sales channels, API keys, and users
starting_price_usd: $49/month (entry tier); ~$99/month for ~1,000 orders/month tier per third-party listings
free_trial_or_freemium: Free trial available (length not publicly specified; 14-day typical per app store listing) [uncertain]
shopify_sync_direction: Bi-directional for inventory; orders flow from Shopify to Sumtracker; product/inventory updates push back to Shopify
shopify_synced_entities: Products, variants, inventory levels (per-location), orders, fulfillments; bundle components decompose at order time. Customers/refunds/draft orders not explicitly documented as synced. [uncertain on draft orders, customers, refunds]
shopify_service_item_support: [uncertain] — Sumtracker focuses on physical inventory SKUs; service item sync not explicitly documented
shopify_multi_store_support: Yes — multiple Shopify stores supported per tenant; products with same SKU auto-linked across stores
shopify_pos_support: [uncertain] — Shopify POS integration depth not explicitly documented
shopify_b2b_catalog_support: [uncertain] — no public documentation of native Shopify B2B catalog / company location handling
shopify_markets_support: [uncertain] — no public documentation of Shopify Markets multi-market pricing / duties awareness
shopify_metafield_to_erp_field_mapping: [uncertain] — no public documentation of configurable metafield mapping
shopify_variant_option_mapping: Mapped by SKU — variants with identical SKUs across stores are auto-linked into a single Sumtracker product; bundles linked to underlying component SKUs
shopify_real_time_or_batch: Real-time webhook-driven inventory sync claimed across all channels including Shopify
shopify_known_limitations: No native Shopify B2B catalog handling documented; users report wanting deeper reporting and tighter Shopify integration in some review feedback; no manufacturing (BOM/production orders) so heavier production users outgrow it
etsy_listing_creation_vs_sync_only: Sync only — Sumtracker syncs existing Etsy listings and inventory; not positioned as a listing creation tool [uncertain on creation capability]
etsy_inventory_sync: Real-time inventory sync between Etsy and Sumtracker; bundle component deductions propagate to Etsy stock levels
etsy_order_import: Automated/real-time order import from Etsy with fulfillment status sync
etsy_synced_entities: Listings, variations (by SKU), inventory, orders, fulfillment status [uncertain on receipts/personalization fields]
etsy_known_limitations: [uncertain] — no public documentation of Etsy personalization / digital product handling specifics
amazon_marketplaces: Multiple marketplaces supported via Amazon SP-API (US, UK, EU, CA, AU at minimum); supports connecting multiple Amazon stores per tenant [uncertain on exact full marketplace list]
amazon_seller_types: Both FBA and FBM supported; Vendor Central not documented [uncertain on Vendor Central]
amazon_synced_entities: Listings, inventory (per fulfillment channel), orders, fulfillment status, cancellations; settlement reports and customer messaging not explicitly documented [uncertain on settlements, returns, messaging]
amazon_listing_creation: Sync existing listings only — Sumtracker manages inventory and order sync, not new listing creation [uncertain]
amazon_repricing_support: No — repricing not a documented feature
amazon_buy_shipping: No — Sumtracker is not a shipping label provider
amazon_fba_inbound_workflow: [uncertain] — FBA inbound shipment creation workflow not explicitly documented as in-app feature
amazon_settlement_report_handling: [uncertain] — no public documentation of settlement report ingestion / accounting posting
amazon_multi_account_support: Yes — multiple Amazon stores can be connected and products auto-linked by SKU
amazon_known_limitations: Focused on inventory sync rather than full SP-API surface; no in-app repricer, no Buy Shipping label purchase, settlement reports / accounting reconciliation not documented
xero_supported: [uncertain] — no direct Xero integration documented; users typically pair with A2X or accounting tools for Xero/QuickBooks reconciliation
xero_app_store_certified: [uncertain] — not found on Xero App Store
xero_synced_entities: [uncertain] — no native Xero entity sync documented
xero_known_limitations: No native Xero integration documented; Sumtracker positions itself as inventory layer alongside dedicated accounting reconciliation tools (A2X-style)
qb_online_supported: [uncertain] — no direct QuickBooks Online integration documented; users typically rely on A2X or similar middleware
qb_app_certified: [uncertain] — not found on Intuit App Store
qb_synced_entities: [uncertain] — no native QBO entity sync documented
qb_known_limitations: No native QBO integration documented; positioned as inventory layer; brands pair Sumtracker with A2X/middleware for accounting
other_ecom_channels: Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Walmart, WooCommerce, BigCommerce. TikTok Shop, Wix, Squarespace, Faire, Square, Magento not documented as native [uncertain on TikTok Shop direct integration]
bundle_kit_component_decomposition: Yes — core strength. Bundles linked to component SKUs; selling a bundle decrements each component, and selling a component recalculates remaining bundle availability in real time. Location-level bundle availability check (only sellable when all components available in same warehouse).
other_accounting_integrations: [uncertain] — no documented native accounting integrations (Sage, Zoho Books, MYOB, FreshBooks, NetSuite, Wave). Customers typically use middleware like A2X.
bom_support: No — no documented native bill-of-materials / manufacturing module; bundles serve as a kit/assembly equivalent but not a true multi-level BOM
production_orders: No — no work orders / manufacture orders / routings
batch_lot_tracking: No — lot/batch tracking not currently supported per their own published comparisons
serial_tracking: No — serial number tracking not currently supported
bin_location_support: [uncertain] — multi-warehouse supported at location level, but sub-location/bin/aisle tracking not explicitly documented
multi_warehouse: Yes — multi-location/warehouse tracking with stock transfers between locations
barcoding: Yes — barcode scanning supported across MacOS, Windows, iOS (via Socket scanners), and Android for Purchase Orders, Stock Adjustments, Stock Transfers and more
purchase_orders: Yes — PO creation, partial receipts, automated PO generation by reorder rules, grouped by supplier into consolidated POs
supplier_management: Yes — supplier records with lead time tracking (Supplier Lead Time Tracker), supplier-grouped POs, supplier prices in PO autofill. MOQ support [uncertain].
landed_cost_support: [uncertain] — landed cost (freight/duty/insurance allocation to inventory cost) not explicitly documented
ai_demand_forecasting: Yes — demand forecasting based on multi-channel sales velocity, historical performance, lead times; positioned as 'AI inventory management' although how much is ML vs rule-based is unclear
ai_purchase_order_suggestions: Yes — automated PO suggestions from forecasting reports with autofilled supplier, quantity, price and shipping details; reorder-point-triggered POs
ai_natural_language_query: [uncertain] — no documented chat-style 'ask your inventory' feature
public_api: Yes — API keys available per plan (each tier has different API key limits), suggesting a public REST API; detailed developer docs not prominently surfaced [uncertain on REST vs GraphQL and documentation quality]
webhook_event_coverage: [uncertain] — inbound webhooks from sales channels supported (real-time sync); outbound webhook events to customer systems not explicitly documented
integration_architecture: Native — direct integrations built by Sumtracker for each channel (Shopify, Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Walmart, WooCommerce, BigCommerce)
mobile_app: [uncertain] — barcode-scanning workflows supported on iOS and Android (via web/PWA + scanners); native dedicated mobile app not clearly documented as a separate iOS/Android app
mobile_barcode_scanning_app: Barcode scanning supported on iOS (requires Socket scanners) and Android (any scanner); used inside Purchase Orders, Stock Adjustments, Stock Transfers
rate_limit_handling_documented: [uncertain] — no public documentation of throttle handling for Shopify/Amazon/Xero/QBO APIs
sync_frequency: Real-time across Shopify, Amazon, eBay, Etsy, Walmart — inventory updates automatically when a sale happens on any channel
shipping_carrier_integrations: None native — Sumtracker is positioned as inventory layer; brands pair it with ShipStation / shipping apps for carrier label workflows
three_pl_integrations: [uncertain] — case studies mention working with 3PLs feeding into Amazon, but no explicit native 3PL connectors (ShipBob, ShipHero, Extensiv) documented
g2_rating: Listed on G2 with reviews (page exists); specific overall star rating [uncertain]
